summary: Cartesia's $0 Free plan includes a shared 20,000-credit monthly pool for Sonic text-to-speech (about 27 minutes) or Ink speech-to-text (about 1h51m), not both full allowances together. It separately includes $1/month in prepaid Managed Agents usage, advertised as approximately 17 call minutes before telephony charges. Agent calls cost $0.06/minute; using a Cartesia-provided phone number adds $0.014/minute for telephony. Free has a limit of one Cartesia-provisioned phone number, not one agent slot, and unlimited workspace seats. No card is required to start. A commercial-use license starts on paid Pro, not Free. Further Agent usage can continue at the same paid rate after the prepaid dollars are exhausted; confirm billing and overage settings before exceeding the $1 allowance.
claim_steps: Open cartesia.ai/pricing and choose the Free plan ('Start free').
Sign up at play.cartesia.ai - no credit card required to start.
Generate speech with Sonic or transcribe with Ink from the playground or API; both draw from the same 20K monthly credit pool.
Stay within the included monthly allowance. Free does not include a commercial-use license; paid Pro adds that license.

For Managed Agents, review the separate $1/month prepaid balance, $0.06/minute calls and $0.014/minute Cartesia-number telephony. Confirm billing/overage settings: usage beyond prepaid dollars continues at the same paid rate.
